gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma Multiforme; Anaplastic Astrocytoma; Fibrillary Astrocytomas; Oligodendroglioma; Diffuse Intrinsic Brainstem Glioma; Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma; DIPG Brain Tumor; H3 K27M
Documented histologic diagnosis of relapsed or refractory glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), anaplastic astrocytoma (AA)

candidate_evidence.quote: Subjects will receive monthly dosing of bevacizumab (15 mg/kg) and cetuximab (200mg/m2)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory Intracranial Glioma in Patients Under 22 Years of Age

agents.agent_name_registered: cetuximab (Erbitux), SIACI of cetuximab and bevacizumab

role_evidence.quote: Participants in this group will receive Cetuximab and Bevacizumab infusion into an artery each month for up to approximately one year.

agents.agent_name_registered: bevacizumab (Avastin), SIACI of cetuximab and bevacizumab

role_evidence.quote: Phase I/II Trial of Repeat Dosing of Super-Selective Intraarterial Infusion of Erbitux (Cetuximab) and Avastin (Bevacizumab)

coder_notes: Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy tested here by a new route (super-selective intra-arterial infusion), so rule 6 applies; cetuximab is then the only non-established investigational agent and is coded experimental_monotherapy (a reader could instead code both as experimental_combination; candidate status is unchanged). H3 K27M appears only in the conditions list and is not an entry requirement in the eligibility text, so no biomarker row. Population includes children (under 22) and adults, with several glioma types.
